Hello and Welcome to Retro Party!
I'm your host, Leafy!
Ask me anything!
Would you like to hear the rules?
Roll the dice to move ahead.
Different spaces do different things. Find out for yourself!
If you can win the minigames, you can earn lots of coins!
But there's more to it than that!
Having a lot of coins is nice, but that's not enough to win the game!
The real measure of victory is stars!
Whoever has the most stars and coins at the end wins!
Even if you have 100 coins, you could still be in trouble if you have only one star.
It's like they say, stars make the world go 'round!
